(주)케이지앤에프 제조 · 1일 1회 1정

이 제품은 구리 1mg, 나이아신 10mg, 망간 2mg, 비타민 A 210μg, 비타민 B1 0.36mg, 비타민 B2 0.42mg, 비타민 B6 0.45mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 아연 3mg, 엽산 120μg, 판토텐산 3mg를 표시량으로 담은 11원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 구리 1mg, 나이아신 10mg, 망간 2mg, 비타민 A 210μg, 비타민 B1 0.36mg, 비타민 B2 0.42mg, 비타민 B6 0.45mg, 비타민 C 100mg, 아연 3mg, 엽산 120μg, 판토텐산 3mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미가 있는 연한 황색의 장방형 정제 · (주)케이지앤에프 제조

Health Functional FoodCopper 1mgNiacin 10mgManganese 2mgVitamin A 210μgVitamin B1 0.36mgVitamin B2 0.42mgVitamin B6 0.45mgVitamin C 100mgZinc 3mgFolate 120μgPantothenic acid 3mgOnce a day

하루 멀티비타민 앤 미네랄Copper · Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)케이지앤에프 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 1mg of Copper, 10mg of Niacin, 2mg of Manganese, 210μg of Vitamin A, 0.36mg of Vitamin B1, 0.42mg of Vitamin B2, 0.45mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 3mg of Zinc, 120μg of Folate, 3mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 1mg Copper, 10mg Niacin, 2mg Manganese, 210μg Vitamin A, 0.36mg Vitamin B1, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 3mg Zinc, 120μg Folate, 3mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)케이지앤에프

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (10mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (2mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (210μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.36mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.42mg / 500mg), 80~180%

Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 500mg), 80~150%

Coliform Negative

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
